split.note: Decided by the user before any test run. Held-out scenarios must not be used for development, tuning or dev-only scoring.

baselines.note: detector_order is set from the M3 dev triage precision (aminer > wazuh > suricata on both dev scenarios); it is a dev-derived, documented choice, frozen on 2026-11-07 before any held-out run. Every k in top_k is reported; agent runs add a k matched to the agent's mean citations per case.

pilot.note: The pilot runs on dev scenarios only; held-out scenarios stay untouched. Both truncation rules are reported side by side; spread runs first. Variants, reachable-only cases and the arms (single, single+verifier, multi, multi+verifier) are the user's pilot decision of 2026-11-10; retrieval = the graph arm's search_attack mode (hybrid measured best on the frozen relevance set, C1 fix).

model.note: No endpoint is committed: set base_url/model here or SENTINEL_LLM_BASE_URL / SENTINEL_LLM_MODEL in the environment. API keys only via the environment variable named by api_key_env, never in this file.

agent.note: Per-case budgets of the M5 single agent; a run whose token bound exceeds run_token_budget needs --confirm.
